name: nexus-browser
description: Minimal, premium, nerd-friendly desktop web browser for power users

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "VITE,MAIN,APP" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:main" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.test:engine: esbuild test/verify-full-engine.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-full.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-full.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-full.js
scripts.test:commands: esbuild test/verify-commands.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-cmd.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-cmd.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-cmd.js
scripts.test:workspaces: esbuild test/verify-workspaces-tabs.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-ws.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-ws.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-ws.js
scripts.test:extensions: esbuild test/verify-extensions.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-ext.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-ext.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-ext.js
scripts.test:library: esbuild test/verify-browsing-library.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-lib.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-lib.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-lib.js
scripts.test:privacy-security: esbuild test/verify-privacy-security.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-sec.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-sec.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-sec.js
scripts.test:devtools: esbuild test/verify-developer-tools.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-devtools.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-devtools.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-devtools.js
scripts.test:qa: esbuild test/verify-release-qa.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-qa.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-qa.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-qa.js
scripts.test:modes: esbuild test/verify-browser-modes.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-modes.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-modes.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-modes.js
scripts.test:visual: esbuild test/verify-modes-runtime.ts --platform=node --target=node20 --bundle --outfile=dist/test-runtime.js --external:electron && electron --no-sandbox --disable-gpu dist/test-runtime.js 2>/dev/null && rm -f dist/test-runtime.js
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:commands && npm run test:workspaces && npm run test:extensions && npm run test:library && npm run test:privacy-security && npm run test:devtools && npm run test:qa && npm run test:modes && npm run test:visual

author: NEXUS Core Team
